string_keys.name: String Key Table
string_keys.description: Table of 3-byte packed string pointers (bank, 15-bit address, bit 23 = compressed flag)

us.notes: Base string key table for US release. Key index is 16-bit offset / 3.

map_table.name: Room Pointer Table
map_table.description: Room id to 24-bit room blob pointer + 1 pad byte

room_enter_scripts.name: Room Enter Scripts
room_enter_scripts.description: Room id to enter script entry (3-byte packed pointer + 2 bytes)

us.notes: Indexed by id*5 via hardware multiplier ($211B/$211C). Overlaps global script pointer table at end.

script_pointers.name: Script Pointer Table
script_pointers.description: Script IDs to 3-byte packed script pointers (bank $92+n, offset | $8000)

us.notes: Readers index relative to script bank base $92:8000 + word[$92:8000].
